What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Unlocks pet deployment, assist pets, quality skills, awakening, affection and toys.
Optimizer_Impact: Do not recommend pet investments before the feature is available.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Exactly one normal pet joins battle and attacks.
Optimizer_Impact: Compare direct pet DPS and owner buffs for the deployed slot.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Two pets may provide assist skills without entering battle.
Optimizer_Impact: Optimize assist skill combinations separately from the deployed pet.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Each pet receives one random assist skill.
Optimizer_Impact: Pet identity and assist-skill roll are separate variables.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Unlocks two Excellent skills, two Epic skills and one Legend skill.
Optimizer_Impact: Quality breakpoints can change both direct pet DPS and owner DPS.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Pet stops attacking and its buffs are inactive until revived by standing near its body.
Optimizer_Impact: Use realistic pet uptime; survival can indirectly protect DPS uptime.

Requirement: Raise the pet to Epic, complete its awakening mission and spend materials.
What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Unlocks the pet's personal awakening skill, skill swapping, gifts/affection and disposition switching.
Optimizer_Impact: Y1 often has more value than a normal rarity increment.

Requirement: Awaken the pet and own the source pet skill at the required quality.
What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Allows swapping inherited deploy skills of the same unlocked quality.
Optimizer_Impact: Optimizer must check whether the source quality skill is actually owned.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Raises deploy-skill slot quality.
Optimizer_Impact: Improves the ceiling of assignable pet skills.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Raises deploy-skill slot quality.
Optimizer_Impact: Can unlock higher-tier owner or pet DPS skills.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Gary and Karen do not support the standard awakening or skill-swapping system.
Optimizer_Impact: Do not generate impossible crystal or affection upgrade actions for these pets.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Each awakening stage raises the maximum affection level and possible player ATK.
Optimizer_Impact: Maximum ATK is not automatic; toys must be spent to fill the new affection levels.

Requirement: Give a preferred toy after awakening.
What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Dog+Cat, Robot+Frog, Fish+Eagle and Turtle+Crab share preferred toy groups.
Optimizer_Impact: Use preferred-toy inventory and current affection cap when valuing gifts.

Requirement: Give a Blue, Purple or Yellow toy.
What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Blue gives 3 ATK/12 HP; Purple 15/60; Yellow 45/180.
Optimizer_Impact: Score ATK for DPS and retain HP only for survival modeling.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Follows the owner and aggressively attacks Elites/Bosses.
Optimizer_Impact: Usually improves boss hit consistency.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Pet neither attacks nor is attacked.
Optimizer_Impact: Exclude direct pet DPS; may preserve owner-buff uptime.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Attacks actively but stays near the owner during boss fights.
Optimizer_Impact: Can improve boss targeting and buff uptime.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Roams if the owner remains mostly still.
Optimizer_Impact: Useful for clearing; may reduce boss focus.

Requirement: Maintain four normal-pet awakening types at Y5.
What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Unlocks the Xeno Pet system; dropping below the requirement removes access temporarily.
Optimizer_Impact: Pet awakening has a system-unlock value beyond pet DPS.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Murica is the strongest straightforward direct-DPS target and is valuable from Y1.
Optimizer_Impact: Prioritize Murica when its boss damage is still a meaningful share of total damage.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Rex or Croaky become strong R5 targets; source recommends one of them to R5 first.
Optimizer_Impact: Simulate owner buffs, vulnerability and pet damage rather than assuming Murica forever.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Raise other standard pets through cheaper Yellow stages before expensive Red stages.
Optimizer_Impact: Compare maximum affection ATK gained per crystal and Xeno unlock value.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Direct pet damage and owner buffs are separate components.
Optimizer_Impact: PetDPS uses attack frequency, damage, crit, cooldown and hit consistency; owner buffs feed the main build formula.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Store HP, reduction, revival and invincibility but do not add them to DPS.
Optimizer_Impact: Add survival constraints separately when a mode requires them.

What_It_Unlocks_or_Changes: Creating one Epic pet from Excellent requires eight Excellent copies in total.
Optimizer_Impact: Include copy opportunity cost before recommending an Epic/awakening breakpoint.
